name: github-sync
conclusion_quantitative: github-sync (Escalate) specifies 5 of 5 categories: 3 autonomy limits, 2 clarification rules, 5 approval gates, 1 validation rule, 1 escalation rule. Strongest: approval gates.
conclusion_qualitative: github-sync synchronises BMAD planning artifacts with GitHub Projects in both directions: onboarding, pushing stories as issues, pulling status back and comparing. Its core rule is that nothing syncs automatically: every change is shown in a sync report and waits for the user's approval. Data ownership is respected on each side, and failed prerequisites stop the workflow.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 3 autonomy limits (3 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There are 3 rules, all strict, none tied to a situation, mostly bullet points. The agent never overwrites data owned by the other side and never parses issue bodies with a script; read-only comparisons run without approval.

statements.quote: **Never auto-parse issue bodies with a script.**
Compare local files with GitHub state without making any changes. No approval needed.

clarification_rules.conclusion_quantitative: 2 clarification rules (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose.
clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: There are 2 rules, both strict, none tied to a situation, all in running text. During onboarding the agent asks whether to use an existing project or create one, and confirms the detected owner, repository and projects.

statements.quote: List existing projects and ask the user whether to use one or create new:
Present detected owner/repo and existing projects. Ask for confirmation before proceeding.

approval_gates.conclusion_quantitative: 5 approval gates (5 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose.
approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: There are 5 rules, all strict, 1 tied to a situation, mostly running text. Nothing syncs automatically: every mutating operation first produces a sync report, and the agent halts and waits for the user's approval before pushing, pulling or setting up.

statements.quote: **Never sync automatically.** Every mutating operation (create issues, update fields, modify files) requires generating a sync report first, presenting it to the user, and waiting for explicit approva

validation.conclusion_quantitative: 1 validation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
validation.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in a bullet point. The agent always checks the existing sync state before creating anything, to avoid duplicates.

statements.quote: Always check for existing sync state before creating.

escalation.conclusion_quantitative: 1 escalation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose.
escalation.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in running text. The agent verifies the prerequisites in order and stops at the first failure.

statements.quote: Before any workflow, verify these in order. Stop at first failure.
